Cyclopes are great smiths and use a giant hammer in one of their camps. In the cyclops and minotaur camp in the Plains of Havoc, beneath the north structure, a quest box holds the {item:Giant Smithhammer}, a {item:Talon} and 100 gp — but the room is full of monsters.
The cyclopes are great blacksmiths and use a giant forge hammer in one of their camps.
Stairs in the north structure of the camp (Plains of Havoc)
The {spell:Invisible} spell (or another way to become invisible) is highly recommended for going down the stairs.
Even a level 30 player loses more than half their health as soon as they go down if they are not invisible. Go invisible or with company.

Go to the camp of {creature:Cyclops|cyclopes} and {wiki:Minotaurs|minotaurs} in the **Plains of Havoc**. The {wiki:Plains of Havoc} are in the south of the continent, **southwest of Venore** ({coord:32747,32258,7}); from Venore walk southwest. Get ready to face many Cyclopes and several kinds of minotaurs.

There are {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}, {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}, {creature:Orc|Orcs} and {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}.
Going down the stairs of the north structure
Go down the stairs of the camp's **north** structure. Down there **many** Cyclopes, Minotaurs, Minotaur Guards, Minotaur Mages and even a few Orcs are waiting for you.
Even a level 30 loses more than half their health immediately if they go down without being invisible.
The quest chest is in the room **immediately south** of the stairs. Open it to receive the reward.

Go back the same way: return to the stairs of the north structure, climb them to the surface ({coord:32779,32235,7}) and walk back to **Venore** (to the northeast). The monsters down there keep attacking while you head back, so do not waste time.
Exit: stairs of the north structure
